If they had been in mischief the evidences of it were not visible among them. If they contemplated mischief, only a reader of minds could have discovered that fact.

arxiv-2110-02163.title: Analysis and Optimization of HARQ for URLLC
arxiv-2110-02163.creator: Faisal Nadeem, Yonghui Li, Branka Vucetic, Mahyar Shirvanimoghaddam
arxiv-2110-02163.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Faisal Nadeem, Yonghui Li, Branka Vucetic, Mahyar Shirvanimoghaddam. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of the hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) technique in providing high-reliability and low-latency in the finite blocklength (FBL) regime in a single user uplink scenario. We characterize the packet error rate (PER), throughput, and delay performance of chase combining HARQ (CC-HARQ) and incremental redundancy HARQ (IR-HARQ) in AWGN and Rayleigh fading channel with m m retransmissions.

arxiv-2110-05377.title: Multiway sparse distance weighted discrimination
arxiv-2110-05377.creator: Bin Guo, Lynn E. Eberly, Pierre-Gilles Henry, Christophe Lenglet, Eric F. Lock
arxiv-2110-05377.description: Abstract Modern data often take the form of a multiway array. However, most classification methods are designed for vectors, i.e., 1-way arrays. Distance weighted discrimination (DWD) is a popular high-dimensional classification method that has been extended to the multiway context, with dramatic improvements in performance when data have multiway structure.

arxiv-2111-03778.title: Analytic non-homogeneous condensates in the ( 2 + 1 ) (2+1) -dimensional Yang-Mills-Higgs-Chern-Simons theory at finite density
arxiv-2111-03778.creator: Fabrizio Canfora, Daniel Flores-Alfonso, Marcela Lagos, Aldo Vera
arxiv-2111-03778.description: Abstract We construct the first analytic examples of non-homogeneous condensates in the Georgi-Glashow model at finite density in ( 2 + 1 ) (2+1) dimensions. The non-homogeneous condensates, which live within a cylinder of finite spatial volume, possess a novel topological charge that prevents them from decaying in the trivial vacuum. Also the non-Abelian magnetic flux can be computed explicitly.

arxiv-2202-01036.title: A pedagagical introduction to the Lifshitz regime
arxiv-2202-01036.creator: Robert D. Pisarski, Vladimir V. Skokov, Alexei M. Tsvelik
arxiv-2202-01036.description: Abstract We give an elementary and pedagogical review of the phase diagrams which are possible in Quantum ChromoDynamics (QCD). Currently, the emphasis is upon the appearance of a critical endpoint, where disordered and ordered phases meet. In many models, though, a Lifshitz point also arises.

arxiv-2210-14905.title: RulE: Knowledge Graph Reasoning with Rule Embedding
arxiv-2210-14905.creator: Xiaojuan Tang, Song-Chun Zhu, Yitao Liang, Muhan Zhang
arxiv-2210-14905.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaojuan Tang, Song-Chun Zhu, Yitao Liang, Muhan Zhang. Knowledge graph reasoning is an important problem for knowledge graphs. In this paper, we propose a novel and principled framework called RulE (stands for Rule Embedding) to effectively leverage logical rules to enhance KG reasoning. Unlike knowledge graph embedding methods, RulE learns rule embeddings from existing triplets and first-order rules by jointly representing entities , relations and logical rules in a unified embedding space.

arxiv-2308-15687.title: Variability of magnetic hot stars from the TESS observations
arxiv-2308-15687.creator: Shen, Dong-Xiang, Li, Gang, Abdusamatjan Iskandar, Fu, Jian-Ning, Zhu, Chun-Hua, Yu, Jin-Long, Zhang, Yu, L u ¨ \ddot{\rm u} , Guo-Liang, Zhai, Nan-Nan, Liu, Jin-Zhong
arxiv-2308-15687.description: Abstract Magnetic hot stars refer to the stars, which effective temperatures approximately in the range from 7,000 to 50,000 K, and with large-scale globally organized magnetic fields. These magnetic fields exhibit strengths ranging from tens of Gauss to tens of kilo-Gauss. They are key in understanding the effects caused by magnetic fields in the stellar evolution.

arxiv-2503-02048.title: FRMD: Fast Robot Motion Diffusion with Consistency-Distilled Movement Primitives for Smooth Action Generation
arxiv-2503-02048.creator: Xirui Shi, Jun Jin
arxiv-2503-02048.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xirui Shi, Jun Jin. We consider the problem of using diffusion models to generate fast, smooth, and temporally consistent robot motions. Although diffusion models have demonstrated superior performance in robot learning due to their task scalability and multi-modal flexibility, they suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) they often produce non-smooth, jerky motions due to their inability to capture temporally consistent movement dynamics, and (2) their iterative sampling process incurs prohibitive latency for many robotic tasks.

arxiv-2507-19563.title: Reply to “Counterfactual communication not achieved yet – A Comment on Salih et al. (2022)”
arxiv-2507-19563.creator: Hatim Salih, Jonte R. Hance, Will McCutcheon, John Rarity
arxiv-2507-19563.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hatim Salih, Jonte R. Hance, Will McCutcheon, John Rarity. In his Comment on our recent paper “The laws of physics do not prohibit counterfactual communication”, npj Quantum Information (2022) 8:60, Popescu argues that the claims of the paper are invalid.

arxiv-2509-00729.title: Edge states, pairing, and sorting of motile chiral particles
arxiv-2509-00729.creator: Raushan Kant, Ananyo Maitra, A K Sood, Sriram Ramaswamy
arxiv-2509-00729.description: Abstract We present experiments on chiral active polar particles, realized as vibrated granular rods, revealing the formation of robust “skipping orbits” at hard boundaries. These edge states exhibit a net circulation opposite to the particles’ intrinsic rotation and lead to a pronounced accumulation at the boundary, stronger than for their achiral counterparts.

pmc-10497534.title: Evaluating the appropriateness of γ-graphyne derivatives as electrode materials for supercapacitors
pmc-10497534.creator: Mahsa Abbasi Kenarsari, Mohsen Vafaee, Mokhtar Nasrollahpour, Seyyed Morteza Mousavi Khoshdel
pmc-10497534.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). DFT calculations were used to study the quantum capacitance of pure, B/Al/Si/N/P-doped, and defective γ-graphyne. Due to the direct relationship between capacitance and electronic states around the Fermi level, structures' electronic properties were evaluated by DOS plots. The results of integrated specific quantum capacitance in the range of water stability potential show an improvement of capacity in each p and n-type doping. The calculated cohesive energies of doped structures reflect the stability enhancement.

pmc-10638229.title: Biochemical diagnosis of Sanfilippo disorder types A and B
pmc-10638229.creator: Soha S Nosier, Seham M S El Nakeeb, Mona M Ibrahim, Mona El-Gammal, Ekram M Fateen
pmc-10638229.description: BackgroundOne of the 11 recognized mucopolysaccharidosis (MPS) diseases is Sanfilippo. It is autosomal recessive in its mode of transmission. There are four subtypes of Sanfilippo (A, B, C, and D). The most worldwide prevalent subtypes of mucopolysaccharidosis type III (MPS III) are A and B followed by C and D subtypes.

pmc-11658688.title: Association of race and area of deprivation index with prostate cancer incidence and lethality: results from a contemporary North American cohort
pmc-11658688.creator: Marco Finati, Alex Stephens, Giuseppe Ottone Cirulli, Giuseppe Chiarelli, Shane Tinsley, Chase Morrison, Akshay Sood, Nicolò Buffi, Giovanni Lughezzani, Andrea Salonia, Alberto Briganti, Francesco Montorsi, Gian Maria Busetto, Craig Rogers, Giuseppe Carrieri, Firas Abdollah
pmc-11658688.description: BackgroundSocioeconomic and demographic factors contribute to disparity in prostate cancer (PCa) outcomes. We examined the impact of Area of Deprivation Index (ADI) and race on PCa incidence and lethality in a North American cohort.MethodsOur cohort included men who received at least 1 prostate-Specifig Antigen (pSA) test within our Health System (1995-2022).

pmc-12418656.title: Blinded gait assessment in idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus: reliability and correlation with clinical and patient-reported outcomes
pmc-12418656.creator: Maria Ekblom, Dag Nyholm, Lena Zetterberg, Katarina Laurell, Johan Virhammar
pmc-12418656.description: BackgroundIdiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus (iNPH) predominantly manifests with gait disturbances, yet clinical assessments are vulnerable to confirmation bias, particularly post-shunt surgery. Blinded video evaluations are a method to enhance objectivity in gait assessment, but their reliability has never been systematically investigated.

pmc-12469821.title: Research Progress on the Application of Food Colloids in Precise Targeted Delivery of Drugs and Bioactive Compounds
pmc-12469821.creator: Yong Guo, Chao Ma, Lianxin Du, Yan Xu, Xin Yang, Aris Giannakas
pmc-12469821.description: With the rapid development of targeted medications and personalized nutritious foods, several bioactive compounds or pharmaceuticals have received a lot of attention for their great functional qualities. However, practical applications confront significant restrictions since these functional compounds frequently exhibit poor solubility and bioavailability during distribution.

pmc-12527176.title: Suppression of kinesin family member-18A diminishes progression and induces apoptotic cell death of gemcitabine-resistant cholangiocarcinoma cells by modulating PI3K/Akt/mTOR and NF-κB pathways
pmc-12527176.creator: Pakornkiat Tanasuka, Phonpilas Thongpon, Sasitorn Chomwong, Suppakrit Kongsintaweesuk, Somchai Pinlaor, Thatsanapong Pongking, Sasithorn Watcharadetwittaya, Chawalit Pairojkul, Kitti Intuyod
pmc-12527176.description: Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA), particularly when associated with Opisthorchis viverrini infection, is often diagnosed at a late stage and exhibits high resistance to chemotherapy, notably gemcitabine. While kinesin family member 18A (KIF18A) is upregulated in opisthorchiasis-associated CCA, its precise function, especially in gemcitabine-resistant CCA, remains largely unexplored.

pmc-12603218.title: Quadratic decomposition based TCN-Transformer for time series prediction of micro-seismic signals in coal mines
pmc-12603218.creator: Yuanping Gan, Chao Huang, Zuoli Zhang, Weidong Lu, Bingpeng Gao, Xin Cai, Tao Xu
pmc-12603218.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). As shallow coal reserves are diminishing in China, mining operations are extended to deeper levels, such that characteristics like high geopressure, intense gas adsorption, and reduced permeability become obvious. The mining environment alters significantly. To monitor geological hazards including rock burst during coal mining, this paper presents a time series prediction model for micro-seismic signals by quadratic modal decomposition and a TCN-Transformer network. At first, the micro-seismic signal is primarily decomposed by CEEMDAN.

pmc-13042733.title: Circulating Microbial Metabolites Predict Tumor Relapse and Chemotherapy Efficacy in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
pmc-13042733.creator: Jun‐Yan Li, Yao Yao, Xi‐Rong Tan, Nan Si, Wei Jiang, Ying‐Qi Lu, Jia‐Hao Dai, Tian‐Tian Yu, Hao‐Cheng Hu, Yu‐Fei Duan, Sen‐Yu Feng, Sai‐Wei Huang, Ye‐Lin Liang, Sha Gong, Na Liu, Yu‐Min Hu, Ying‐Qing Li
pmc-13042733.description: The value of microbial metabolites in prognosis and treatment response prediction in patients with nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) remains unclear. Here, through the untargeted metabolomic analysis of plasma in 48 paired NPC patients with or without tumor relapse, we identified distinct circulating metabolite atlases between NPC patients with different prognoses.

pmc-13252613.title: In Situ Formation of an In–Zn Interface Layer Enables Aqueous Zinc‐Ions Batteries with High Capacity Retention
pmc-13252613.creator: Youwei Jiang, Jinghao Li, Jie Huang, Tan Qiu, Xiuwen Song, Fujun Deng, Yongxue Wang, Yue Ming, Ziping Wu, Qinyou An, Yaoguang Rong
pmc-13252613.description: For aqueous zinc ion batteries (AZIBs), inhibiting side reactions is the key to enhance the stability. Particularly, the issues of uneven deposition and hydrogen evolution reaction have attracted intensive attention. We propose to construct an In–Zn interface layer between the separator and anode to induce uniform deposition of metallic zinc.
